population.kidComparison: About 70.5 million people live in Tanzania—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Warm tropical climate year-round with distinct wet and dry seasons.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Tanzania
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Tanzania.

exploration.didYouKnow: Tanzania is located in Eastern Africa and its capital city is Dodoma.
